sort: Drag safety rules to the right place (Home: do not touch knife, do not play with matches | School: walk slowly on stairs, do not push | Road: use footpath, look left-right-left)
extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT use speechManager.speak() anywhere in the game. Only use audioManager.play() for sound effects. Valid sound effects: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint. Teach: (1) Sharp objects (knife, scissors, broken glass) — never touch without a grown-up. (2) Fire (matches, candles, stove) — never play with matches or go near a lighted stove. (3) Electricity (switches, sockets) — keep wet hands away, never put fingers in a socket. (4) Falls (stairs, chairs, wet floor) — walk slowly on stairs, never climb furniture. (5) Road (cars, buses) — hold a grown-up hand, walk on footpath, look left-right-left. Misconceptions: "a small matchstick cannot do any harm" (a single matchstick can light curtains in seconds), "wet hands are fine for switches" (water conducts electricity, keep wet hands away), "running on stairs is fun" (walking slowly on stairs prevents falls). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function SafetyGame), NOT export default. Export interface SafetyGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
